kicker: HOW NAVY SEALS START EVERY DAY
title: Train before your day *starts*

label: BOOT CAMP
head: Wake up, work out, then eat
sub: Every recruit's day starts the same way. Nobody asks how they feel.

label: SEAL TEAM
head: Still fitness first, every morning
sub: Years later the order is the same. It works, so they never break it.

label: AFTER THEY LEAVE
head: They skip it, gain weight, start drinking
sub: The habit dies the day nobody forces it.

head: The excuse vs the truth
l: No reason to be in shape anymore
r: Your kids need you strong at 70

text: You want to live long for your kids, but you won't *lose 40 lbs* for them?

label: TOMORROW
head: 20 minutes before your phone
sub: Push-ups, a run or a kettlebell. Train, then eat, then check messages.
